exercise.name: Burpee
library_steps: From standing, squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position and do one push-up.
Jump your feet back in, then jump up with your arms overhead.
exercise.one_line_summary: Two pictures: standing tall, feet hip-width, arms relaxed (start); high plank at the top of the push-up, arms straight under the shoulders, body one straight line from head to heels on the toes (end).

setup.target: Standing, feet about hip-width, arms relaxed at the sides.
Hands under the shoulders, arms straight, body straight - hips neither high nor sagging.
setup.tolerance: hip within 0.05 m of the shoulder-ankle line

movement.measure: body line angle from horizontal (spec root rot X = 90 - this)
movement.end: about 22 deg (shoulders 0.65 m up, ankles 0.15 m up)

movement.measure: arm vertical to the floor (elev in torso frame)
movement.end: 68 (= straight down in world when the body is at 68)

movement.measure: end: on the toes, heels up

muscles.role: The burpee is a conditioning drill (library primary: cardio); used as a VO2 field test (S2).
Squat down and jump up (NASM primary).
Hold the plank line (NASM secondary: core).

mistakes.why_it_matters: Strains the low back; counts as a failed rep in S2.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Bottom up in an inverted V.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Not a plank; failed rep in S2.

sources.citation: National Academy of Sports Medicine. Squat Thrust Burpees (exercise library).
sources.what_it_gave: Stand hip-width, squat, hands outside the feet, feet back to push-up position, one push-up, feet in, jump with arms overhead; don't let hips drop; primary quads, pecs, glutes; secondary triceps, delts, core, hip flexors.

sources.citation: Yamashita Y. 2023. The 3-minute burpee test: a minimalistic alternative to the conventional estimated oxygen uptake test. Cureus 15(3):e35841.
sources.what_it_gave: Four stages: squat, plank, push-up, jump; begin and end standing; plank with hips too high or too low = failed rep.

clip_check.target: hip within 0.05 m of shoulder-ankle line

clip_check.check: End: hands on the floor under the shoulders
clip_check.target: lowest hand point -0.005..+0.005 m; hand y within 0.08 m of shoulder y

clip_check.check: End: toes on the floor, heels up
Red spread: quads/chest/glutes lit, no single muscle dominating
